Game Overview

At its heart, Flying Bunny is a animal game about control a nimble bunny gliding through vibrant skies. Tap to keep it airborne, collecting eggs for points and clocks for precious time. Master timing to dodge obstacles in this fast-paced arcade adventure, where every second counts and charm meets challenge. Can you reach a record-breaking score?

Playing Flying Bunny comes down to a simple loop. Control a nimble bunny gliding through vibrant skies. Tap to keep it airborne, collecting eggs for points and clocks for precious time.
